note: The edits of assets/models/penguin/penguin-arms-crease.glb against penguin-arms-pit.glb, in the units of the studio (README.md, "penguin-arms-crease.glb"), in their order. Each merge joins the vertex at `from` to the vertex at `to` on the welded mesh, at the place of `to`: the faces that the merge makes flat go, and each other face of the `from` vertex takes the `to` vertex as its corner and keeps the UVs of its own corners. No vertex goes to a new place.
